stock.description: Grand Ming Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, engaging in a variety of business ventures across Hong Kong. Its core activities include building construction, property leasing, and real estate development. The construction division is responsible for erecting residential and commercial structures, as well as specialized data centers. Through its property leasing segment, the company rents out data centers and various commercial retail units. Additionally, the property development arm focuses on the creation and sale of real estate properties. Established in 1995, the firm's main office is located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, and it functions as a subsidiary of Chan HM Company Limited.
